settings.title: Change the World of Migration With Us

settings.editor: We’re looking for driven people to join our international team. Help redefine global mobility — from Lisbon, Malta, and beyond. If you’re ready to bring your best to a company that values ambition and excellence in equal measure, we’d love to hear from you.

settings.title: A Place Where Ambition Meets Purpose

settings.editor: We build careers alongside client journeys. Our culture is rooted in curiosity, respect, and shared ambition.
We foster a positive, open environment where ideas flow freely and people work together — with respect, clarity, and shared goals.
Our team is diverse in background and experience — and that’s our strength. We value curiosity, empathy, and openness to different views, cultures, and ways of working.
We work in a fast-moving, global space. That means staying flexible, informed, and ready to adapt — to client needs, market shifts, and the world around us.
Explore our current openings and discover how you can make an impact at Global Citizen Solutions. We have a variety of roles waiting for passionate individuals like you.
Act as the primary point of contact for clients and support process management throughout the residency or citizenship application journey.
Be our researcher with a commercial mindset, turning economic and financial data into insights that drive business and market growth.
We’re always looking for people who think globally. Send us a spontaneous application and let’s explore how you can contribute to our mission.
